name: Regression-based FisherRF
definition: A variant of FisherRF that replaces direct variance-to-pixel mapping with a meta-regression model, using grouped Gaussian parameter variances as input feature maps to predict pixel-wise uncertainty.
summary: Regression-based FisherRF predicts pixel-wise uncertainty by feeding grouped Gaussian parameter variances into a meta-regression model, replacing standard FisherRF's direct variance summation.
